The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Adds flowers on the graves, unlit candles, flower pots on the corner and gate piers, moss carpet on the wall tops, vines on the gate piers and leaf bushes outside the front wall.
notes.artefacts: Same as L2: the yew canopy wraps the cross's west arm and top ((3,2,10), (2,3,10), (3,4,10)). Flower pots are empty in the file (the decoration step adds the plants), fine.
notes.roof: Lychgate roof as in L2: steep, slab ridge, front/back overhang. The automatic overhang warning is a false alarm.
notes.life: Flowers, candles, moss, vines, bushes and lanterns: lively without clutter.

visual.summary: L2 plus flowers and candles on the graves, moss on the wall tops, vines on the gate piers, flower pots, bushes outside the wall and a fresh grave; the most finished, lived-in level.
problems: Yew canopy still covers the cross's west arm and top: clear the leaves at (3,2,10), (2,3,10), (3,4,10) or move the tree so the cross stands free.
Yew trunk only 2 logs high (2,1,9)-(2,2,9) with leaves from y2: raise it so it reads as a tree.
Reachability: 85 of 121 standing places reached; all paths, graves and benches reachable. Unreached are the lychgate roof, tree tops and pier tops, fine.
